_comment: UI fit findings that are right by design. Key: "<rule>|<control key>" from test-artifacts/ui-fit/<device>/<screen>.json. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can check. Known bugs never go here: fix them.

exemptions.clickable-is-control|clickable:svg[mini-: The desktop mini-map is a pointer shortcut for panning. Keyboard users move around the graph with card focus and Zoom to fit, so it is not a separate control.
exemptions.clickable-is-control|clickable:path.edge: A connection line's wide invisible hit area is a pointer shortcut to the connection editor. Keyboard and screen reader users reach every connection through the graph's "connections · Browse" button (each row has Edit), and labelled connections are buttons themselves.
